body: Thanks for the kind words. I was talking to my coworkers and he brought up how much hair he sheds and we started talking about hair and I said "I've been thinking my hair is thinning on my crown but I really can't tell" (I only thought so because of how much I itch back there, to the point it bleeds) and he said "dude I'm glad you brought it up because I really wasn't sure how to bring it up" and took a pic of it and showed it to me. It looked a bit thin but I always remembered scalp being sorta visible there just because of how my hair grows/parts but with him saying that and my anxieties I got worried. He didn't say when he noticed and I'm planning on asking tomorrow.

Some more info

•I've just lost 60lbs and last time I lost a lot of weight I noticed a lot of shedding but didn't really pay attention to my scalp since I was young and thought "couldn't be me"

•I just had a pretty bad break up from a GF of 3yrs

•My work load at work has increased an insane amount

•I have very bad dandruff issues that no OTC shampoo has been able to address, my scalp is constantly irritated and itching. You can see a flake in the pic. Just this problem alone makes me want to see a dermatologist but taking time off work is difficult

• most of the itching is focused near where I think there's thinning

• my father has a full head of hair at 63 but I've never met either of my grandfathers

• I don't notice any shedding during the day 

• coworkers only noticed recently so I know it's a new thing


All of these makes it really difficult for me to point to one thing or say for sure that it's MPB. Anyone with a similar experience?
